name: keep-going
description: Retries a turn that died on a transient API error (500, 529 overloaded, timeouts, connection resets) with backoff, and resumes work when the usage limit resets.

maxRetries.title: Retries in a row
maxRetries.description: How many times in a row a turn that failed on a transient API error is retried (backoff 30s, 60s, 120s, 240s). A successful turn or anything you type resets the count.

maxPerSession.title: Retries per session
maxPerSession.description: Hard cap on retries and resumes sent in one session.

resumeAfterLimit.title: Resume after the usage limit resets
resumeAfterLimit.description: When a turn stops on the 5-hour or weekly limit, send a resume prompt one minute after the window resets.

display.title: Where to show a pending retry
display.description: band draws a row with a countdown and a cancel button above the prompt; status writes the countdown to the status line.
